title: Chart quiz #16
caption:
Chart quiz #16. Think you can read the next move?

Q1: Real or fake breakout?
Q2: Will this new high hold?
Q3: Breakdown, or bear trap?

Each chart pauses so you can comment your answer, then plays on to show what happened, and why.

Tell me your score: 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Practise reading charts at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

#MemeStreet #ChartQuiz #Breakout #RSI #LearnToTrade
narration: Three charts. Three new skills to test. Breakouts, momentum and traps. Question one. Price just closed above resistance. Real breakout, or fake? Fake. The break came on thin volume, and price couldn't hold above the level. Real breakouts usually hold it on a retest. Question two. Price just made a new high. Now check the RSI panel underneath. Will this new high hold, or fail? It failed. Price made a higher high, but RSI made a lower one. That divergence showed momentum fading. It's a warning, not a certainty. Question three. Price just dipped below support. Is this a real breakdown, or a bear trap? A bear trap. The dip came on thin volume, then buyers snapped it straight back above support. Sellers who shorted the break got caught. How many did you get? Tell me your score in the comments. Practise on real charts from the game, at memestreet.net.
